name: Ops Runbook
description: Write an operational runbook or playbook a tired on-call engineer can follow at 3am without thinking — covering when to use it, prerequisites, numbered step-by-step procedures, verification, rollback, and escalation. Scopes the exact scenarios and prerequisites FIRST, writes unambiguous copy-pasteable steps with expected output and verification at each stage, then has a reviewer pressure-test it for gaps and dangerous ambiguity. Use for incident response, deploy/rollback procedures, and recurring ops tasks.
